title: Welcome at JAVC Management & Consultancy
subtitle: The website of Jeroen A. van Craaikamp in Amstelveen, Netherlands.
text: After building up skills and 20+ years of experience as an internal employee, since 2022, companies can hire me as self-employed project/program manager, platform/product owner or architect in the Service Management workspace, utilizing IT4IT platforms such as ServiceNow.
intro: The "[Articles/Publications](/articles/)" page features a few dozen blogs about the various things that keep me busy.

blocks.heading: What I do
blocks.text: Together with stakeholders and agile team members, I plan, procure, innovate, integrate, implement and manage IT products/platforms for large enterprises.

blocks.heading: So far
blocks.text: Over the last decades, I managed IT4IT and CSM projects/teams, as internal employee or external consultant in various technical, commercial and managerial roles.

blocks.heading: For who
blocks.text: I worked for companies such as KPN, Belastingdienst, KLM, Ericsson China, Tellabs, ING Bank, CRH, Digital Realty, IKEA, Booking, Action, Brenntag, and Stater.
